nodes.description: Internal storage slot holding the address of the delegated implementation contract used by the proxy fallback.
Private storage slot holding the address of the proxy upgradeability owner (privileged role).
Public view getter returning _upgradeabilityOwner.
Internal setter that writes the privileged owner address into _upgradeabilityOwner.
Public view getter returning the current implementation address _implementation.
Public pure function returning EIP-897 proxy type id 2.
Payable fallback that reads implementation() and delegatecalls all calldata to it, returning/reverting with the raw result.
Internal function that validates a new implementation and writes it into _implementation, emitting Upgraded.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == proxyOwner() before executing the guarded function body.
Public view returning upgradeabilityOwner().
Owner-guarded function transferring proxy ownership, emitting an event and calling setUpgradeabilityOwner.
Owner-guarded function updating the implementation address via _upgradeTo.
Owner-guarded payable function that upgrades the implementation and then delegatecalls arbitrary calldata against the proxy itself.
Constructor that sets the owner, sets the initial implementation and delegatecalls attacker-supplied calldata.
Caller address controlled by external accounts; used for the onlyProxyOwner access check.
Low-level delegatecall executed in the fallback with gas, calldata and full returndata forwarding to the implementation address.
Low-level delegatecall of caller-supplied bytes data on address(this) after an implementation upgrade.
Low-level delegatecall of constructor-supplied calldata on the initial implementation during deployment.
State write that replaces the delegatecall target, permitting arbitrary code execution through the fallback.
State write that changes the privileged owner account controlling upgrades.
Parameter of setUpgradeabilityOwner(address) holding the new owner address.
Parameter of _upgradeTo(address) holding the new implementation address.
Parameter of transferProxyOwnership(address) holding the new owner address.
Parameter of upgradeTo(address) holding the new implementation address.
Parameter of upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) holding the new implementation address.
Parameter of upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) holding calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Constructor parameter holding the initial upgradeability owner.
Constructor parameter holding the initial implementation address.
Constructor parameter holding calldata delegatecalled on the initial implementation.
Local variable in the fallback storing the implementation() result used as delegatecall target.

edges.reason: upgradeabilityOwner() returns the value of _upgradeabilityOwner.
implementation() returns the value of _implementation.
setUpgradeabilityOwner writes the privileged owner state variable.
_upgradeTo writes the delegatecall target _implementation, which controls all fallback execution.
transferProxyOwnership calls setUpgradeabilityOwner to reassign the privileged owner.
transferProxyOwnership reads proxyOwner() for the ownership-transfer event.
upgradeToAndCall first calls upgradeTo(implementation).
Constructor calls setUpgradeabilityOwner(owner).
Constructor calls _upgradeTo(initialImplementation).
upgradeTo delegates to internal _upgradeTo.
proxyOwner() returns upgradeabilityOwner().
msg.sender is compared against proxyOwner() inside the onlyProxyOwner modifier.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of transferProxyOwnership.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of upgradeTo.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of upgradeToAndCall.
onlyProxyOwner reads proxyOwner() to resolve the current owner.
Fallback reads implementation() to obtain the delegatecall target address.
Fallback performs a delegatecall into the implementation, which can re-enter the proxy.
_implementation state value flows into the fallback delegatecall target.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls attacker-influenced data, allowing re-entrant execution.
data parameter is forwarded directly into the delegatecall performed by upgradeToAndCall.
implementation parameter is passed to upgradeTo.
Constructor delegatecalls calldata on initialImplementation, executing external code at deployment.
initialImplementation receiver address flows into the constructor delegatecall.
Constructor calldata is forwarded into the delegatecall.
initialImplementation is passed to _upgradeTo.
newUpgradeabilityOwner is written to owner state by setUpgradeabilityOwner.
implementation parameter is validated and written to _implementation by _upgradeTo.
newOwner parameter flows into transferProxyOwnership logic and event.
implementation parameter flows into upgradeTo.
implementation parameter flows into upgradeToAndCall.
data parameter flows into upgradeToAndCall and into its delegatecall.
owner parameter flows into the constructor and then to setUpgradeabilityOwner.
initialImplementation parameter flows into the constructor.
calldata parameter flows into the constructor.
Local _impl stores implementation() result inside the fallback.
Local _impl is used as the target address of the fallback delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only used to write the owner state variable inside setUpgradeabilityOwner; it carries no independent semantics.
Parameter is validated and written to _implementation directly in _upgradeTo.
Parameter is only consumed by transferProxyOwnership for the event and owner update.
Parameter is passed straight to _upgradeTo inside upgradeTo.
Parameter is only forwarded to upgradeTo as part of upgradeToAndCall.
Parameter is the exact payload executed by the delegatecall, so it belongs to that unsafe operation.
Parameter is only used to set the upgradeability owner during construction.
Parameter is both stored as implementation and used as the delegatecall target in the constructor.
Parameter is the exact calldata executed by the constructor delegatecall.
Local variable only caches the implementation address used as the delegatecall target in the fallback.
